_meta.evidence_tags: [S:id] source read; [T] trade knowledge unverified; [I] inference

asset_catalog.asset: Reception scale · báscula · balança
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Weighs each delivery: platform, hanging or truck scale [T]
asset_catalog.design_reference: Volume units (lata, cajuela) are farm-specific, so record kg [S:R3]

asset_catalog.asset: Hopper · tolva (seca/húmeda), recibidor · moega
asset_catalog.design_reference: 45° walls; treated dry wood; sized on 2 % of annual production as daily peak; cherry 610 kg/m³ [S:AT058] (621.6 [S:AT370]); < 500 @/yr: the pulper's own hopper suffices [S:AT058]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Clean daily [S:ANA18]. Greased gauge-6 plastic covers caught 7,714 borers/m²; regrease each harvest [S:AT297]. Self-heating [S:AT589]

asset_catalog.asset: Holding area · reserva, estopas, canastillas · área de espera
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Pre-pulping hold; deliberate cherry rest (R6 FFFD, CryoBloom)
asset_catalog.design_reference: Trial containers: burlap sacks; also bags, crates, hoppers, hermetic containers [S:AT589]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Mass 38–41 °C after 48 h in sacks [S:AT589]; a rest batch rising 8.8 °C to 34.2 °C cupped "sucio" [S:AT554]

asset_catalog.asset: Air pre-cleaner · prelimpiador neumático · pré-limpeza
asset_catalog.design_reference: Penagos AP-20: 20,000 L cherry/h, 5 HP, 520 kg [S:PEN-AP20]

asset_catalog.asset: Siphon / flotation tank · tanque sifón, criba de flotes · separador hidráulico
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Separates floaters (dry, empty, borer-damaged) from sinkers
asset_catalog.design_reference: Penagos: up to 1,500–32,000 kg/h; float strainer; 3–8" outlets; CR or stainless [S:PEN-SIF]. Water 1.6 L/kg cherry, clean, not recirculated [S:AT454]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Clean daily [S:ANA18]; dirty water favours OTA [S:CX69]

asset_catalog.asset: Wet destoner · despedregador · despedregador
asset_catalog.design_reference: Stainless 304 + PVC, 500 × 2,880 mm [S:PEN-DST]

asset_catalog.asset: Cherry sorting · selección manual u óptica · catação
asset_catalog.design_reference: For modified fermentations: ≥ 80 % ripe, < 2.5 % unripe, no overripe [S:AT554]

asset_catalog.asset: Transport · transporte hidráulico, sinfín, elevador, gravedad · transporte
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Channel/fruit pump, screw, bucket elevator, gravity
asset_catalog.design_reference: Gravity, screw or cable-disc conveying saves > 50 % of water [S:AT187]. Screw capacity m = 15π(Di² − d²)·p·ρ·N·fc, cherry ρ 616.5 kg/m³; dosing screws 2–4" at 84–172 rpm [S:AT405]. Upper floor above 500 @/yr [S:AT058]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Water transport of pulp contaminates water [S:AT187]

asset_catalog.asset: Horizontal drum pulper · despulpadora de cilindro horizontal · despolpador horizontal
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Pressure and friction of cylinder against breast (*pechero*) and jacket (*camisa*) [S:HUI7]; manual or motor; 1–6 jets (*chorros*)
asset_catalog.design_reference: Works without water [S:AT164, PEN-DH4]. Cenicafé-INGESEC 300: 300 kg/h, Ø 14 × 22 cm cylinder at 232 rpm, gap set with galvanised shims [S:AT294]. Penagos DH-4: 400–450 kg/h, 0.75 HP [S:PEN-DH4]. No. 3 machine: 1 HP at 150–180 rpm [S:AT058]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Damage, unpulped fruit, pulp in coffee, coffee in pulp (V-PUL) [S:AT294]; "guayaba" defect from maladjustment or poor floater removal [S:HUI7]. Sample coffee and pulp, recalibrate as needed, respect capacity; clean after each shift [S:ANA18]

asset_catalog.asset: Vertical pulper · despulpadora vertical · despolpador vertical
asset_catalog.design_reference: Penagos DV-255: 2,000–2,500 kg/h, 2 HP, stainless jacket, grey-iron breasts; claims < 2 % damage/"cascareo" [S:PEN-DV255]

asset_catalog.asset: Disc pulper · despulpadora de discos · despolpador de disco
Re-passer · repasadora · repassador
Screen · zaranda/criba · peneira rotativa
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Separates pulped coffee from unpulped fruit and pulp
asset_catalog.design_reference: Rotary 60 cm Ø × 2 m at 30 rpm serves four No. 3 pulpers [S:AT058]; built into Penagos UDC units (1,000–1,200 kg/h, zero water) [S:PEN-UDC]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Overload sends first-quality coffee to seconds [S:ANA18]

asset_catalog.asset: Pulp conveyor · transporte de pulpa · transporte de polpa
asset_catalog.design_reference: Screw conveying [S:AT187]; Becolsub screw mixes pulp and mucilage [S:AT405]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Pulping + water transport of pulp = 82,080 mg COD/kg cherry, 72 % of load [S:CEN66]

asset_catalog.asset: Upflow demucilager · desmucilaginador (Deslim, DELVA) · desmucilador
asset_catalog.design_reference: Granjerito: 744 kg cherry/h, 0.89 kW, 870 rpm, 1.09 L/kg cps, 0.68 % damage; Granjero: 2,400 kg/h, 4.85 kW, 0.6 L/kg cps, 0.8 % [S:AT217]. DELVA 1,000–10,000 kg/h [S:PEN-DELVA]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Residual mucilage ferments in the dryer [S:HUI7]. Rest 24 h in clean water changed every 6–8 h; ripe fruit only [S:ANA18]

asset_catalog.asset: Becolsub · Becolsub · —
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Waterless pulper + Deslim + screw mixing pulp and mucilage
asset_catalog.design_reference: 300–2,500 kg cherry/h; 0.7–1.0 L/kg cps; flow set by orifice plate (1/8" at 200 mm head → 0.87 ± 0.16 L/kg cps), rotameter (1.5–15 L/min) or 4.5–8 W pump [S:AT405]; avoids ≈ 90 % of pollution [S:CEN66]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Leachate ≈ 110,000 ppm COD [S:CEN66]; re-*aforo* (timed volume) on drift [S:AT405]

asset_catalog.asset: Ecomill · Ecomill® · —
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Natural fermentation in a 60° cone tank, then mechanical washing
asset_catalog.design_reference: Models 500/1,500/3,000: 435–2,817 kg/h; 0.32–0.53 L/kg cps; 1.6–4.0 hp; damage 0.10–0.56 %; removal > 95 %; 16–20 h fermentation or 2–3 h with pectinase; daily full wash of stainless parts [S:AT432]

asset_catalog.asset: Enzyme dosing · dosificación de enzimas · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: 2–3 h fermentation [S:AT432]; SM-1 bioreactor accepts enzymes [S:PEN-SM1]

asset_catalog.asset: Tanque tina · tanque tina · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: 120.5 × 92.5 cm top, 104 × 72 cm bottom, 85 cm deep ≈ 600 L for a 600 kg-cherry peak; two tanks; 30 % free volume; V_baba (L) = 0.666 × kg cherry; central drain, 1½" ball valve, 3/16" holes at 1 cm; light colours; 4 rinses 5–10 cm above mass; 4.1 L/kg cps vs 25 traditional [S:AT408]

asset_catalog.asset: Washing channel · canal de correteo / semisumergido · canal de lavagem
asset_catalog.design_reference: 30 × 30 cm, tiled, 0.5 % slope, 5–20 m [S:AT058]. Running: 18.7 L/kg, 450 kg/h, 18.9 % good beans lost; semi-submerged 3.2 L/kg [S:AT241]

asset_catalog.asset: Hydrocyclone · hidrociclón · hidrociclone
asset_catalog.design_reference: Ø 35 cm, 73° cone, inlet 13.8–34.5 kPa, 1,640 kg/h, 1.9 L/kg, 71.6 % impurities removed, 12.4 % good beans lost [S:AT241]

asset_catalog.asset: Mechanical washer · lavador (Ecowasher) · lavador
asset_catalog.design_reference: Ecowasher 1500: 1,000–1,500 kg/h, 1 HP, 0.5 L/kg cps [S:PEN-EW1500]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Drain and spread at once; piled washed coffee gives post-fermentation and "cebolla" [S:ANA18]; reused water stains beans [S:HUI7]

asset_catalog.asset: Open tank · tanque/pila de fermentación · tanque de fermentação
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Dry or underwater; concrete, tiled, epoxy, stainless-lined or plastic [S:HUI7, AT422]
asset_catalog.design_reference: 1 m³ per 24 @ cps at 12 h; floor 8 % to outlet; knife gate with grille [S:AT058]. Mass 50 cm–1 m with good drainage; underwater: change standing water every 10–12 h, pool ≤ 72 h [S:ANA18]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: No wood, corroding metal or flaking paint [S:AT422]; clean daily [S:ANA18]; shade and ventilate [S:AT554]

asset_catalog.asset: Conical tank · tanque cónico · tanque cônico
asset_catalog.design_reference: FDA-approved MDPE, cylinder Ø 1.22 × 1.50 m (1.75 m³) + 0.80 m cone at 60° (0.38 m³), 0.23 m outlet, ≈ 1.45 t coffee; dry discharge 41.8 t/h (63.4 stainless 430); > 20 yr; 63 % cheaper than AISI 304; same cup [S:AT496]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Weak-acid resistant, less so to strong acids [S:AT496]

asset_catalog.asset: Sealed tank / bioreactor · biorreactor hermético · biorreator
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Anaerobic, SIAF, CO₂/N₂-flushed, carbonic (R6 axis B)
asset_catalog.design_reference: Penagos SM-1: 300–5,000 L, hermetic wafer valves, CO₂/N₂ quick connector, **0–15 psi (0–103 kPa) adjustable**, 71–132 L leachate tank, manhole [S:PEN-SM1]. BioMáster PRO adds logged pH, soluble-solids and temperature sensors and yeast/bacteria dosing [S:PEN-BM]. Sealable drains; insulated, refrigerated jackets [S:AT454]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Warm closed systems: phenolic/earthy taints [S:AT454]; O₂-restricted runs: herbal notes, excess acetic/butyric/propionic risk [S:AT554]. CO₂ asphyxiation in rooms and pits [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Drums & barrels · bidones, canecas, barricas · bombonas, barris
asset_catalog.design_reference: Food-contact polyolefins: 21 CFR 177.1520 (extractables, density classes) [S:CFR]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Wood not recommended [S:AT422]; check prior contents [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Bags · bolsas herméticas / de ensilaje · sacos herméticos
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Sealed whole-cherry and river-flow ferments [S:R6 A07]
asset_catalog.design_reference: GrainPro sells hermetic storage bags, no fermentation specs [S:GP]

asset_catalog.asset: IBC tote · IBC · contentor IBC
Fittings · válvula de alivio, airlock, muestreo, termopozo · válvulas
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: One-way CO₂ release, relief, gas inlet, sampling, probe wells
asset_catalog.design_reference: One-way valves in tropical carbonic maceration [S:R6 C03]; 0–15 psi [S:PEN-SM1]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Stuck valve: over-pressure or air ingress; inspect gaskets each run [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Jacket + chiller · chaqueta, chiller de glicol · camisa
asset_catalog.design_reference: Insulated, refrigerated jackets; trials at 15 ± 1 °C [S:AT454]

asset_catalog.asset: Cold room · cuarto frío · câmara fria
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Cherry cold hold (CryoBloom 9–12 °C [S:R6]); baba < 8 °C [S:AT422]; green at 10–12 °C [S:AT590]
asset_catalog.design_reference: Cenicafé room: 10.3–12.2 °C, 60–90 % RH [S:AT590]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Condensation on removal; seals, defrost, alarms [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Freezer · congelador · freezer
asset_catalog.design_reference: Borer kill: ≤ −15 °C for ≥ 48 h [S:R2]

asset_catalog.asset: Immersion bath · tanque de choque térmico · banho
asset_catalog.design_reference: No published temperatures [S:R6]

asset_catalog.asset: Yeast fridge & rehydration vessel · nevera · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: Storage and rehydration values in V-FER-14–17; rehydrate in clean, ideally sanitised equipment; submerged ferments ≤ 1 cm water above mass; dry ferments sprayed evenly [S:FER-CB, FER-CBT, FER-DA]

asset_catalog.asset: Patio · patio (cemento, ladrillo, asfalto, tierra, lona) · terreiro
asset_catalog.design_reference: Cement, ≥ 1 % slope; 1 m² per 5 @ cps/yr at 3.5 cm loads [S:AT058]; 27 m²/t cps [S:AT281]. Acceptable: cement, brick, tarpaulin, bamboo/sisal mats, raised mesh tables [S:CX69]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Bare soil unsuitable in rainy areas; plastic canvas stays humid underneath; surface must be cleanable [S:CX69]. Not on a hot patio (parchment cracks), avoid > 40 °C, don't mix days [S:ANA18]. Treading, dirt, ash [S:AT371]

asset_catalog.asset: Raised bed / tray · cama africana, pasera · terreiro suspenso
asset_catalog.design_reference: Cenicafé pasera: 150 × 100 cm, 65 cm high, black PE 4 × 4 or Red 5000 mesh, 3 cm, 90 kg cherry (18.75 kg cps), stackable at 30 cm, gauge-6 cover vented both faces [S:AT345]. East-African beds ≈ 0.8–1 m high, ≤ 1.2 m reach [T]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Lower stacked tray dries slower (142 vs 79 h) [S:AT345]

asset_catalog.asset: Covered/shaded bed · cama cubierta, polisombra · terreiro coberto
asset_catalog.design_reference: 80 % shade mesh added 4.6–6.3 d (up to +72 %), no cup gain [S:AT577]

asset_catalog.asset: Parabolic / tunnel / marquesina · secador parabólico, túnel · secador solar
asset_catalog.design_reference: Parabolic: 6.5 × 4.0 × 2.10 m, 50 cm side openings, N–S axis, ≤ 3 cm, 19.5 kg wet/m², 260 kg cps, 7–15 d, cover 3–5 yr [S:AT305]. Doors open early, ~20 % mid-drying, closed at night/rain; river stones under floor; perimeter drain; away from odours [S:AT577]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Night rewetting below 20 % moisture [S:AT577]. Clean covers with water, no detergent; paint frames white [S:AT305, AT577]. Coloured covers slow drying [S:AT577]

asset_catalog.asset: Modular polycarbonate dryer · secador solar modular · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: 2 × 2 m modules; solid 3 mm PC 96 → 90 % transmission, > 8 yr vs PE film every 2–3 yr; 40–47 % faster; inside 17–45 °C, 70–79 % RH; solar extractor on hygrostat at > 95 % RH inside (off if > 95 % outside), 0.072 kWh/cycle [S:AT575]

asset_catalog.asset: Rolling roof / carts · casa elba, carros · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: Carts ≤ 3 cm; parabolic dries 23.5 % faster than carts [S:AT281]. Casa elba geometry not found [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Dark/controlled room · cuarto oscuro deshumidificado · sala climatizada
asset_catalog.design_reference: Large dehumidifier + fans, total darkness; Panama example at 18 °C [S:R6]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Dehumidifier sizing not sourced; condensate drainage [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Static-layer silo · silo secador (1–3 niveles) · secador de camada fixa
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Batch drying through a fixed layer
asset_catalog.design_reference: ≤ 40 cm [S:AT282, HUI7]; < 35 cm, stacked ≤ 75 cm [S:AT576]. Cenicafé 2-chamber silo 60–500 @; 3-level 12–500 @, 0.1–0.3 m/level, 20–24 h, batch out every 8 h; fans 2–5 HP for 80–160 m³/min at 6.2 cm H₂O [S:AT282]. Penagos SC: 10–20 @ cps, 0.75–1 HP, 2 lb gas per 12.5 kg cps [S:PEN-SC]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Damp coffee left in a stopped silo: dirty, mouldy, earthy, phenolic, smoky [S:AT371]. Remove Gravimet before stirring blades run [S:AT580]

asset_catalog.asset: Rotary drum · guardiola · secador rotativo
asset_catalog.design_reference: Pre-dry 8–10 h; fill Pinhalense-type drums 100 % (+10–12 % batch, no stripping or shine) [S:ANA18]. Penagos SG-7/9: 7–9 m³, 2,625–3,775 kg cps, 5–7 HP + 5 HP fan, multi-fuel [S:PEN-SG]; QDryer 900 L, 4 rpm, LPG 1 kg/@ [S:PEN-QD]

asset_catalog.asset: Vertical dryer · secadora vertical · secador vertical
asset_catalog.design_reference: Penagos Ecodryer: 5,000–15,000 L wet parchment/day, stainless exchanger, automatic fuel feed, 75–90 kg cisco/m³, 15–35 HP [S:PEN-ED]

asset_catalog.asset: Furnace / heat exchanger · hornilla, intercambiador, quemador · fornalha
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Cisco, pulp, wood, coal, LPG, diesel, electric, solar
asset_catalog.design_reference: kJ/kg: cisco 17,936; coal 33,440; wood (20 % m.c.) 15,412 [S:AT380]; dried pulp 16.5 MJ/kg, 3.5 % ash [S:AT591]. Exchanger target > 50 % efficiency and < 50 % of the grain layer's air resistance (tested 45–52 %); thermostat 48–52 °C [S:AT380]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Combustion gases, stored fuels, direct firing → discoloured, crystallised, smoky beans [S:AT371]; coal sulphur forms acid [S:AT282]

asset_catalog.asset: Covers & tools · carpas, rastrillo · lonas, rodo
asset_catalog.design_reference: Rake: 8 × 4 cm teeth, 105°, 3 m handle [S:AT281]; cuts drying time 25 % [S:AT577]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Ventilate wet coffee at night; heap and cover after 1 d (parchment) / 3 d (cherry) [S:CX69]

asset_catalog.asset: Rest bins · reposo, cajones de madera · tulhas
asset_catalog.design_reference: Cool 8–10 h under sacks, never bag hot; rest ≥ 3–4 weeks [S:ANA18]

asset_catalog.asset: Warehouse · bodega · armazém
asset_catalog.design_reference: ISO: ≈ 22 °C, RH ≤ 60 %, > 0.8 m from walls, ≥ 2 m to ridge, insulated roof, waterproof walls and foundations, insulated pipes, rodent/bird-proof, dark with aisle-only lights, short wall to the sun [S:ISO8455]. Codex: damp-proof cement floor, no flooding, pipes away from coffee, high ceiling, no sun or heat sources [S:CX69]. Anacafé: wooden pallets, 50 cm from walls, 20 °C / 65 % RH [S:ANA18]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Segregate odorous, chemical, dusty goods and rejects; organic apart from fumigated lots [S:ISO8455]; no non-food materials [S:CX69]. Broom-clean; pest programme by a recognised agency [S:ISO8455]

asset_catalog.asset: Cold store (green) · cuarto frío · câmara fria
asset_catalog.design_reference: 10–12 °C held quality 240 d; low T with 69–77 % RH reached one year [S:AT590]

asset_catalog.asset: Packaging · fique, yute, bolsa hermética, vacío · juta, big bag
asset_catalog.design_reference: From 11.8 %: fique/paper ≈ 15 % after 365 d; PE-EVOH, vacuum PE-PAV, PE-doble, PP-PVC, PE-Multi, PE-Max ≤ 12.34 %; fibre bags 7.6–9.0 % discoloured after 240 d; weevil *Araecerus fasciculatus* in fique; high-barrier beyond 60 d [S:AT590]. Clean jute sacks [S:ANA18]

asset_catalog.asset: Containers & trucks · contenedor · contêiner
asset_catalog.design_reference: Clean, dry, undamaged; cross-stacked bags; absorbent top/side cover; liners off the roof; vents free; ≤ 12.5 % throughout [S:CX69]. Port ≤ 72 h; moisture before loading and on arrival [S:ISO8455]

asset_catalog.asset: Pulp pit / covered compost · fosa de pulpa techada · fossa de compostagem
asset_catalog.design_reference: Volume (m³) = 0.002 × annual kg cps (500 @ → 2 × 2 × 3 m); zinc lean-to roof; cement floor 2 % outwards; concave drain floor with central grate; compartments turned; 4–6 months [S:AT068]. Ecomill structure ≈ 4 × 2 m, plastic-lined walls, impermeable 2 % floor, ≥ 500 L leachate tank [S:AT538]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Borer emergence: greased covers [S:AT297]; leachate runoff [S:AT068]

asset_catalog.asset: Washwater into pulp · aguas mieles sobre pulpa · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: 2–3 kg pulp per L retains 83–89 % in 24 h; recycled leachate 100 % by 35 h; spray daily by 2" hose or pump [S:AT538]. Becolsub retains ≈ 66 % of mucilage in pulp [S:AT405]

asset_catalog.asset: Vermicompost · lombricompost · vermicompostagem
asset_catalog.design_reference: 5 kg worms decomposed 1 m³ fresh pulp in 80 d; humus showed reversible nursery toxicity [S:AT161]

asset_catalog.asset: Dried pulp fuel · pulpa seca combustible · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: 78.2 % → 8 % moisture in a 3 mm-polycarbonate solar tunnel; 19.2 % yield; 0.39–0.45 kg/kg cps; S 0.10 %, Cl 0.05 %; store in sealed clean plastic bags [S:AT591]

asset_catalog.asset: Cascara drying · secado de cáscara · casca
asset_catalog.design_reference: Off-ground, food-contact surfaces, food-safety plan [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Lime + settling · tratamiento con cal, sedimentador · decantador
asset_catalog.design_reference: Raw tina washwater pH 3–4, COD 25,000, TSS 2,700 mg/L; Ca(OH)₂ 4.0–5.2 g/L → pH 7.9–8.1, TSS −75–81 %, COD −37–49 %; jar test 120 rpm 5 min + 60 rpm 25 min, settle 24 h; then Fe/Al coagulants (pH 5–11) [S:AT537]

asset_catalog.asset: Primary leachate system · STLB · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: Solids tank (UCI) 2 × 1 × 1 m, flooded, packed with 15 cm guadua pieces (48.2 m²/m³, 77.8 % porosity) behind 3 mosquito-mesh layers; drying bed 2 × 1 × 0.5 m on 30 cm gravel; pre-acidifying filter 5.5 × 1 × 1 m of hand stone + 5 cm limestone (4 : 1), 85 cm level. COD 110,000 → 36,200 ppm (−67 %), BOD −73 %, outlet pH > 5; 1 labour-day/yr; re-plaster UCI every 2 yr [S:AT280]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Sludge 74 L (50 g TSS/L) per 33.5 t cherry [S:AT280]

asset_catalog.asset: Anaerobic reactors · SMTA, biodigestor, UASB · reator anaeróbio
asset_catalog.design_reference: Tina residues go to SMTA [S:AT408]; biodigesters for washwater [S:AT187]. Retention/loading not found [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Green filter · filtro verde · fertirrigação
asset_catalog.design_reference: Pretreated water on fast-growing trees/grasses tolerant of partial saturation [S:AT548]

asset_catalog.asset: Leachate evaporation · evaporación en secador · —
asset_catalog.design_reference: Dried product N 2.87 %, K 4.24 %, pH 5.6, EC 8.36 mS/cm [S:CEN66]; Ecomill dried "honey" 26.5 kg/t cherry [S:AT432]

asset_catalog.asset: Pre-cleaner · prelimpiadora · pré-limpeza
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Screens + aspiration for dust, sticks, stones [T]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Dust; partitions or extractor fans where cleaning shares a store [S:CX69]

asset_catalog.asset: Destoner · despedregadora · despedregador
Parchment huller · trilladora, morteadora · descascador
asset_catalog.design_reference: Washed hulling loss 17.75–18.40 % [S:AT370]; cps : green 1.25 [S:R3]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Breakage from wrong gap or moist coffee; heat [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Dry-cherry huller · descascadora de natural · descascador de coco
asset_catalog.design_reference: Husk 54.6 % of dry-cherry mass, green 45.4 % [S:AT557]
asset_catalog.failure_modes_hygiene_maintenance: Husk at 16.8 % moisture vs whole cherry 10–12 % [S:AT557]

asset_catalog.asset: Polisher · pulidora · polidor/brunidor
Pneumatic separator · catadora · catador
Screen grader · clasificadora por zarandas · classificador de peneiras
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Round holes in 1/64" steps; oval slots for peaberries
asset_catalog.design_reference: Multi-tier sloped vibrating screens; European Prep ≤ 5 % below screen 15 [S:RC2]

asset_catalog.asset: Gravity table · mesa densimétrica · mesa densimétrica
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Removes light, chipped, hollow beans and foreign matter by angle and vibration [S:RC3, RC4]

asset_catalog.asset: Optical sorter · seleccionadora electrónica · selecionadora óptica
asset_catalog.function_subtypes: Removes discoloured, immature, insect-damaged beans; glass, stones, plastic, sticks
asset_catalog.design_reference: RGB and infrared (SORTEX A LumoVision), paired with mechanical cleaning [S:BUH]; > US$100,000, hundreds of bags/day [S:RC3]; UV for stinkers [T]

asset_catalog.asset: Hand sorting · escogida manual · catação manual
asset_catalog.design_reference: ≈ one 60 kg bag per sorter per day [S:RC3]; light ≥ 4000 K/1,200 lx [S:R3]

asset_catalog.asset: Magnet, metal detector · imán, detector · ímã, detector
Bagging scale · báscula ensacadora · ensacadeira
asset_catalog.design_reference: Quintal 46 kg (CR); export sack 69 kg [S:R3]

asset_catalog.asset: Capacitance moisture meter · determinador de humedad · medidor de umidade
asset_catalog.design_reference_method: Senses capacitance, temperature, bulk density; repeatability is the real accuracy [S:CTAHR]. Under-reads warm coffee: equilibrate ≥ 30 min [S:AT580]. Cenicafé MH-2 used for washed coffee [S:AT481]
asset_catalog.calibration_maintenance: ISO 24115: ≥ 5 reference samples 8.5–13.5 %, 0.7–1.3 points apart, conditioned 72 h airtight, ≥ 3 readings each, k = 2 [S:ISO24115]. Annual pre-harvest cross-check vs ISO 6673 [S:CX69]; measure at room temperature [S:AT371]

asset_catalog.asset: Oven · estufa
